peer_hello.effect: introduces a verified public identity plus ordered authenticated lifecycle records and capabilities into in-memory non-trust state only
peer_hello.lifecycle_policy: rebuild from the initial identity by applying authenticated rotation/status records in sequence; re-introduction may advance but never roll back locally retained lifecycle state

envelope_pipeline: Ed25519 verification under frozen Phase 2 clock limits
durable replay record with active-window retention and compaction
recipient_policy: a valid envelope is admitted only when recipient equals the local node ID; mismatched recipients are rejected before replay recording

replay_policy.derivation: max signed-message lifetime 3600 + two 300-second skew margins
replay_policy.compaction: prune records older than the active replay window, atomically rewrite and fsync before continuing
replay_policy.exhaustion_policy: active-window state that still exceeds the hard bound fails closed

retrieval_policy: objects and provenance are served only from explicitly registered local export bytes; missing content returns 404 and never triggers outbound retrieval
ssrf_policy: no URL-bearing fetch field, no outbound HTTP client, no redirect-following, exact sha256 retrieval paths only

rate_limit_source_policy.proxied_public_mode: x-qsol-client-ip accepted only when the direct socket peer equals the explicitly configured --trusted-proxy IP

tls_profile.reference_pattern: loopback/private service behind an explicitly configured upstream TLS terminator whose socket IP is pinned as trusted proxy for rate-attribution only

fuzz.ci_smoke: deterministic parser/admission mutation test in src/api.rs

gate: public network listening is opt-in and the reference service is claimable only while replay retention/compaction, limits, lifecycle-aware identity verification, local routing, adversarial tests, and parser/admission fuzz smoke are green
